title: The Triangle Inequality
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 1 "Ones and twos balance and petronella 1½ places, 1st robins face threes below" isn't drawn yet.
Row 2 "In groups of three, balance and petronella 1 place, 3rd robins face up" isn't drawn yet.
Row 3 "Top four balance and petronella 1 ½ places to a ring of four" isn't drawn yet.
Row 5 "pass through to partners" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 7 "Ones and threes circle left ¾" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 8 "neighbors do si do once and threes face up" can't start from where the dancers are: Nobody is called "neighbor" here.

choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
